Patch Notes from 07.20.2020
notes.content:
The Update is now available!

With each update, we are working on improving the balance, filling the game with events and trying to make it more friendly for beginner.

This update will be a major milestone for the development of our project. Basically, it will concern changes in three game modes: "Dark Tower", "The Pit" and "Raids".

As part of the update, these modes will become available much earlier, which will allow many players to familiarize themselves with their content and receive valuable rewards!

General changes:
-  Now the modes "Dark Tower", "The Pit" and "Raids"alternate

- Modes cycle: Dark Tower -> The Pit -> Raids
- Each mode is available for 1 week. After this period, a new mode opens, and access to the previous one disappears.
- “Dark Tower”, “The Pit” and “Raids” open simultaneously when you reach league 20.
- The complexity and rewards of “The Pit” and “Dark Tower” depend on the total amount of the player’s might at the time of entering the current mode.
- Medals for passing Dark Tower and the Pit - changed.
The maximum medal for completing the Dark Tower is 20.
The maximum medal for completing the Pit is 15.
Previous medal progress will be saved.
- On the main screen, under the name of each of the modes, you will see timer showing the time remaining until the start of the next session.

- Coins from the “The Pit” and “Dark Tower” replaced with one common currency.
- Now, in “Raids” mode, you will receive сopper coins for sending troops to attack or defense.

- Old coins from the “The Pit” and “Dark Tower” are automatically converted to the Copper coins (the maximum number of Copper coins is 30,000, 6% of the current number of mode coins will be converted)
- The shops of Dark Tower ”, “The Pit” and “Raids” are combined into black market that will delight all our players!
- Also, "Black Market" will be available in "Raids" mode which uses a copper coins.
- Black Market e in the “Dark Tower”, “The Pit” and “Raids” refreshes every 24 hours.
- The number of store refreshes depends on the VIP level.

- Gold has been removed from the summon and only hero cards will drop out.
- A restriction on receiving gifts from friends has been introduced (you can receive as many gifts as you send yourself). This is done to exclude farming of friendship coins. Regular players will not be affected
- Fables with the reward in Pit and Dark Tower coins deleted and replaced by 1 Fable, giving an increase of 100% of received coins. Bonus for receiving coins in “Raids” was added to this Fable
- Added quests for receiving and spending coins from the modes
- Daily, weekly and epic quests - changed (new ones introduced and some old ones changed)

- Added new epic quests:
New quest to kill heroes
New quest to summon heroes
New quest to win in PVP
New quest to increase the rank
New quest to increase the level of the hero

- Reward for daily quests in which you received gems - increased
- Redistributed the points of weekly and daily quests.
- Some daily quests will change periodically.
- Some rewards for daily, weekly and epic quests have been increased.
- There is a chance to get in the final reward of weekly quests, a card that is not in your collection (up to 500 cards of 1 hero)

- Questlines have been simplified for starter leagues
- Weekly fables deleted. Old ones will remain in place.
- Reduced the amount of power received after reborn legendary heroes
- Requirements for Soulbind will change (the 2nd,3rd, and 4th soulbind will unlock simultaneously with the 1st soulbind but will also require heroes and souldust)

- The following timers have been moved to 18:00 (UTC):
Opening modes
Updating stores
Quest update
Updating the Divine Arena
Updating of the Gems mine

- The Battle Chamber window became more informative
- Soul dust removed from arena chests
- In "Dark Tower" - guaranteed drops soul dust
- Battle Pass bugs fixed
- Bugs in the friends system fixed
- Bugs with quests updating fixed
- Rewards for ending the season increased starting from League 25
- Minor bugs and errors fixed
- Minor visual changes
- Game chat updated

The Pit Changes:
- The number of bosses has increased to 10. The complexity and number of rewards grows with each subsequent boss.
- The complexity of the bosses and reward will depend on the total might of the player’s collection at the time of entering the mode, the complexity does not change until the current mode is completed.
- Every day 2 bosses will be opened (Maximum can be 10 bosses per week)
- 1 Key update - 12 hours

Dark Tower Changes:
- Entring the dark tower is now free
- The game will add a parameter of fatigue. If you lose, you will spend attempts (skulls), but over time they will recover. You can wait for their recovery, or recovery them for gems.
- Wasted attempt in the dark tower restored 12 hours
- The strength and rewards of opponents increases as you progress through
- Now for the full passage of the “Dark Tower” is required to defeat 16 opponents
- The reward for the epic quest for the full passage of the “Dark Tower” increased
- The victory quest in PVP counted in the “Dark Tower”
- Rewards given for every victory. A small consolation bonus in the form of copper coins will be issued for the defeat)

Raid Changes:
- Now, when attacking and defending, a copper coins will be issued that can be spent in the modes store
- At the same time, active game and attacking the castles of other players will give you more coins
- The more troops you send, the more coins you can get.
- Selection of opponents and rewards depend on the total might of the player’s collection. We will be glad to receive feedback from you to further improve the system of selection of opponents.
- Visually changed the progress bar and receive awards

notes.title: Update 16.12.2019
notes.content:
Heroes!

The New Update is now available!

As you may have noticed, everything's a bit different now.
You see, Christmas Eve and *New Year's Eve *are almost here! Pangea is covered in snow and soon you'll drown in our presents and pleasant surprises :)

Anyway, now we're moving on to the What's New section:

1) Visual improvements for the Shop.

2) Fixed an error with purchasing Premium at the Battle Pass.

3) We've fixed our medal delivery system for completing a Battle Pass.

4) We've fixed an error in Prince Gleedy's 3rd Skill.

5) Fixed a send-an-receive issue regarding Friendship Coins.

6) Small visual bugs were fixed.

New changes regarding the Autofight:

1) From now on, there will be no Autofight in Divine Arena and Brawl game modes.

2) Autofight is ON by default in Battle Chamber, Journey and Gold Mine game modes.

3) Autofight is OFF by default In Dark Tower and the Pit game modes.

4) Watch out! The "on/off" Autofight button state is saved independently in each game mode!

5) Although, from now on, you can go to the Settings menu and just turn the Autofight off manually in all the game modes. Still, you'll be able to turn it back on during your next battle.

notes.title: Update 14.11.2019
notes.content:
Heroes!

The Update is now available!

Friendship system revised:

1) From now on, your friends are displayed in a new, more compact format. Each player can have 32 friends max. If you had more, the number has reduced to the limit (the most active friends have remained).

2) There is a button "Find" in your Friend List. If you click on it, you’ll see a list of your possible friends, those recommended to you.

3) Friend Shop was  dissolved. Now you can send Friend Coins directly from one to another.

4)A gift counter was added. Now you can check how many presents you can give to your friends daily. There are Friend Coins inside these presents. 

5)A new button was added. With one single click you can send presents to all of your friends and collect presents sent to you.

Teacher/Disciple system revised:

1) From now on, every player who reached League 28  automatically becomes a disciple of some more experienced player. If you are not happy with the choice, you may change your teacher.

2) List of the disciples is now displayed on a separate tab. You may become a teacher once you reach League 15. If you haven’t reached this League but you became a teacher anyway, all of your disciples will remain intact.

3) Each teacher can have 15 disciples max. If you want to take an extra one, one of your disciples will perish. Only the last 15 disciples will remain intact.

4) Teachers receive 5 Gems for each dollar of their disciples spent on the in-game offers. 

Other changes:

1) Visual improvements for a window of your friends’ card requests. 

2) "Rookies" summon was replaced with the "Friends" summon, which can be activated by spending Friend Coins. The amount of Friend Coins you had until the present update will be automatically converted to Gems.

3) "Sudden Death" warlord skill was fixed. From now on it always deals the same damage.

4) Fixed an error with the game freezing after an extra summon.

5) A new quick-win opportunity in the Events (if your difficulty mode is "Easy").

6) Visual fixes.

notes.title: Mighty Party Update 06.05
notes.content:
Heroes!

The new update is available!

We have re-evaluated all in-game resources and it was decided to implement some rebalancing changes:

Gold:

1) From now on, gold is available only in the Journey Shop (as well as in the main shop), though the offers now are even more advantageous to you than they were before.

2) Quantity of gold in Daily Bonuses is now decreased.

3) It was decided to decrease the HP level of golden statues at the first leagues in the [937600]Gold Mine mode. In the meantime, the total amount of gold you get is decreased.

4) PvP chest rewards will provide more gold than before. The higher your League, the bigger the difference.

5) There is no more Gold in the Dark Tower and Pit chests.

6) Max amount of stocked gold is increased to 3 million.

Golden Dust:

1) Gold Dust will be renamed to Soul Dust.

2) From now on, Soulbind can be activated only by using Soul Dust. For that reason, Pal Points will no longer be used in the game. All the Pal Points will be converted into Soul Dust.

3) Active VIP Soul Dust bonuses are decreased.

4) From now on, Soul Dust is available only in the Dark Tower Shop, though the offers now are even more advantageous to you than they were before.

5) PvP chest rewards provide you more Soul Dust than before.

6) A chance to get a PvP chest with Soul Dust is now increased.

7) Now you have a chance to receive Soul Dust in the Dark Tower chests.

Elixir:

1) From now on, Elixir is available only in the Pit Shop (as well as in the main shop), though the offers now are even more advantageous to you than they were before.

2) An elixir is included in the Pit chests.
Game Mode changes:

1) From now on, you can read your adversary’s info during your PvP battle with him/her.

2) Guild Masters and Guild Officers can pin their messages in the Guild chats.

3) From now on, the Guild Master is relieved from his duties after 14 days away from the game. If the Guild Master remains inactive for 22 days, he will be automatically excluded from the Guild.

4) A new feature of an instant win for players who reached League 24 was added in the Journey mode (if your boss’ difficulty level is «EASY»).

5) From now on, in order to get into the Dark Tower mode you need to win 7 fights on all platforms.

6) In the Raids mode, the reward for the destruction of castles is increased.

7) The Guild will receive Influence after each event chapter completed by the Guild members.

Visual improvements:

1) A new animation of chest drops.

2) The EXP bar now displays the current quantity.

3) Visual changes of the world rating: an indicator showing all the position changes in the world rating was added.

Other changes:

1) An X10 Rookie Summon feature was added.

2) In-game nicknames no longer consist of swear words.

3) The amount of gems is now decreased in the «Heroic Line-Up» offers.

4) The first ability of Mina Hellsing is fixed.

5) The Turf Wars rewards display error was fixed. Rewards will be delivered for every cell captured.

notes.content:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28289343/2fabb76394cbe4c5b83d73f35629d6e2df1ee08c.png
Heroes! You have grown your guilds for the last couple of months Now it's time to show who has the strongest alliance of guildmates, reveal your tactical genius and ability to work as a team. "Turf Wars" are here!

✔ "Turf Wars" is a new feature where Guilds fight against each other for the most valuable territories. All guilds are divided into rooms depending on their rate in Guild Rankings, first time based on the current rating (the summary Fame of the guild members), in all subsequent times it will be based on "Turf Wars" result. Amount and quality of the rewards in the room depending on the rating of the guilds in this room.

✔ How are "Turf Wars" going:
Battlefield is a map of 6x5 cells. Guilds conquer cells, starting from the side of the map, gradually moving to the middle, where the most valuable territories are placed.
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28289343/265c3bd28d1b50cf88c9dc1b1c4c505cd3a677d3.png

✔ Guild members send their cards to conquer cells. Three times a day "Clash" happens, where the system determines who got the cell. 
Cells are conquered or held by a guild or a neutral faction that has more "Power" on this cell at the moment of "Clash"(attack option will be blocked 5 minutes prior).

✔ The difference between winner's "Power" and the current "Defense" of the cell becomes "Defense" of this cell for the winner. Guild members of the winner could send cards to improve "Defense" of the conquered cell. When the Guild controls cell, it can attack adjacent cells, but not diagonally.
For example: 
Guild А and Guild В attacked the cell that has 50 points of basic "Defense". Guild A sent 100 "Power", Guild B sent 30 "Power". After "Clash" Guild A will control this cell, basic "Defense" of the cell will be 50 points.
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28289343/2cacccb8127c40909819e316c80d8ab05b31acc7.png

✔ "Turf Wars" game cycle is one week. It starts on Friday at 18:00 UTC, and ends on the next Friday at 18:00 UTC. Rewards are delivered every day at 18:00 UTC. 
"Clash" happens three times a day at 00:00 UTC, at 12:00 UTC, and at 18:00 UTC. On the last "Clash" on Friday at 18:00 UTC Guilds get doubled rewards for the last day, the new map is generated (Landmarks are shuffled etc.), Guilds are distributed in Guild Rankings and new rooms are formed depending on new Guild Rankings.

✔ "History"(scroll on the right side) shows cells condition during the last some "Clashes". It clearly illustrates the course of "Turf Wars".

✔ How players attack territories:
Each guild member can choose any available cell and send his cards there. Available Cards are the personal card collection of the player. "Power" of the cards is determined by its rarity and promote level. Stats, skills, "Soulbind" and "Reborn" aren't counted. So, "Power" of cards in "Turf Wars" isn't the same as "Might" in regular PVP.
Sent cards are blocked (but only in "Turf Wars") till the end of the day. And the player can't use those card for conquering other cells.

✔ Territories:
Each cell is neutral at the beginning of "Turf Wars" and has basic "Defense", type of landscape, rewards. Some cells have Landmarks.
Landscape gives a bonus to cards "Power" that was sent attack/defend this cell. For Example, Wood gives a bonus to Nature cards.
Rewards: Rating Points and Influence are added to Guild, Contribution is added to every player individually (see below). Rewards are delivered to the Guild that is held or conquered the cell at the end of the day.
Landmarks give an additional reward. It could be gold, gems, cards etc.
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28289343/d1f4ed9b179caf0eb21f656398766ccba026286e.png

✔ How rewards are distributed among guild members:
Each guild member gets a percent of general guild "loot" depending on his personal contribution in "Turf Wars". The better player's cards, the more cards player has, the more active the player, the bigger his personal reward will be. Guild member that doesn't participate in "Turf Wars" doesn't get rewards.
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28289343/f93e438a709e11560910b7b28910df9d9a765e0f.png

✔ Guild Shop:
In general, Guild Shop is an evolutionary tree of the different bonuses. Guild Master and Officers unlock and upgrade bonuses for Influence; guild members buy temporary bonuses for themselves. For example, decreasing the cost of card promotes, additional HP to Warlords, +1 Block to all heroes with Block etc.
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28289343/18a754d9105ca15f194ee8f224626d22357afa42.png

✔ New guild currency: Elixir
How to obtain it:
Each guild member gets it every day. The amount depends on Guild level;
Sold as a regular lot in "Bank".

How to spend it:
To increase "Power" of cards on a specific cell in "Turf Wars". Each player increases only "Power" of his own cards.
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28289343/c651543c2bba954d260dedbb7009599decb79a76.png

Other Changes:

✔ Journey Fights against "Trees" are faster now;

✔ Special Summons have x10 option now;

✔ Chances to get Epic card in "Demigod" summon slightly increased;

✔ "Medals" interface redesigned. Added a lot of new medals.

✔ "Queen Ananta"
Stats slightly rebalanced;

✔ "Draggara"
Stats slightly rebalanced;

✔ "Knight"
+3 ATK to all allies with Block" is no longer works on hero himself;

✔ "Karas"
Stats slightly rebalanced;

✔ "Orc-Master"
Stats slightly decreased;
The second skill changed: Death: Give Double Attack to a random Chaos Ally(was Death: Give Double Attack to a random ally);
